## Problem

a steeped pot goes bitter because nobody remembers when it started

## Outcome

every pot is poured at its steep time

## Decisions

### dc-1 — steep times come from the ADR's table <a id="dc-1"></a>

Steep times come from the ADR's table.

## Constraints

- **co-1** no network access <a id="co-1"></a>

  No network access.

## Acceptance criteria

1. **ac-1** a started pot reports its remaining steep time <a id="ac-1"></a>
   - Evidence: behavioral.
   - Coverage: not yet planned.

   A started pot reports its remaining steep time.

2. **ac-2** a pot past its steep time raises an alarm <a id="ac-2"></a>
   - Evidence: behavioral.
   - Coverage: not yet planned.

   A pot past its steep time raises an alarm.
